title: when a slice's Why text matches an open item's title, list that item as a likely duplicate in the brief's Direction section

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
The reviewer reported this as tool feedback (deterministic-check) on ork in ork run ork-20261125-134345-8b83, project ork, item S552:

when a slice's Why text matches an open item's title, list that item as a likely duplicate in the brief's Direction section

Evidence: S550 "name -render-fixture and the fixture list in the UI pass brief's CLI text renders section" duplicates S552's scope

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body: Owner decisions (2026-11-25): What rule decides that an open item is a likely duplicate of the slice in the Direction section? -> why-containment: count the open item's title words (the `titleWords` set) found in the slice's Why text. List the item when the share is at least a threshold you name, for example 0.6. This matches "Why text matches a title" and can catch the S550/S552 case. It needs a new helper and a threshold. The empty Files, Failing tests, Implement and Check sections are then filled per your 2026-11-25 `tighten` note. [feedback.direction-duplicates].
